judgment.notes: Compared the complete P signature in type-Check.lean with spec H001–H006 and the contract binders. n,m:ℕ with 1≤n∧1≤m retain both positive integer dimensions; u has real Euclidean spatial and target coordinates, and q is one fixed unit vector. H002 demands joint smoothness only on 0<t. H004 and H005 have the original spatial and positive-time quantifiers; H005 is pointwise ∃a:ℝ for utt−Σj uxxj=a•u, without a selected smooth scalar or the derived explicit PDE as input. H006 quantifies each real 0<s<t, chooses one compact C for the entire closed interval, and asserts equality with that same q outside C. H003 is retained in P although unused locally. The final domain is nonvacuous: for positive dimensions a constant unit map satisfies all hypotheses. Through implementation helpers the direct frontiers are R001: H002,H004,H005; R002: H001,H002,H006; R003: H002,N002; R004: H001,H002,N002; R005: H002,N001,N002,N003,N004, with Mathlib freely available. There are no additional external assumptions, object fields, scalar-field changes or hidden target-bearing construction fields.

scope: Coverage is reviewer-reported; reading alone is not mathematical assessment.
